evidence.summary: status.json written every cycle with heartbeat, per-component state/detail/pid/adopted/launches, link and public check codes; link.html with stale-heartbeat banner; supervisor log (10 MB roll) and per-launch component logs (3 generations); scripts/cip-supervisor-status.ps1 reads it all plus a direct Redis PING; status swap measured 0 missing reads in 300 rewrites (MoveFileEx).

rationale: Every state change and restart is logged with reason; operator can read state without the agent. No off-machine alerting (out of scope by design).
